name: St Kilda
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: St Kilda is a remote archipelago about 65 kilometres west of North Uist in the Outer Hebrides. Its sea cliffs, the highest in the UK, host huge colonies of puffins and gannets. Islanders lived here for roughly two thousand years, leaving behind stone storage huts called cleitean, more than 1,200 on Hirta alone, until the last 36 residents were evacuated in 1930.
